text.description_html:
First Impressions 3621/7-US26 Contemporary Chrome Shower Door Pulls

This new contemporary designed shower door pull is constructed of durable non rusting aluminum and finished in bright Polished Chrome. Sleek 90 degree mitered ends add to the shower door pulls clean fresh look.

This glass shower door pull set fits 6" center to center (distance between the two (2) mounting holes in the glass). Easy to install with all the included mounting hardware.

Specifications of First Impressions 3621/7-US26 Contemporary Shower Door Pulls

  • Total Length: 7"
  • Mounting Center to Center: 6"
  • Pull Width: 1"
  • Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Material: Non Rusting Aluminum
  • Finish: Polished Chrome

Packaged with 2 door pulls and includes all the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
